rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb when physically knocking someone unconscious or incapacitating them.

example.english: A single blow can stun someone.
example.jyutping: jat1 gwan3 ho2 ji5 zoeng1 jan4 daa2 wan4

rows.note: Use this everyday spoken verb for suddenly frightening or shocking someone.

example.english: Seeing a snake can really stun me.
example.traditional: 見到條蛇真係會嚇親我。
example.jyutping: gin3 dou2 tiu4 se4 zan1 hai6 wui5 haa5 can1 ngo5

rows.note: Choose this for serious or public-news shock, especially when a person or event causes widespread surprise.

example.english: The news of this accident could stun the whole world.
example.traditional: 呢宗事故嘅消息可以震驚全球。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung1 si6 gu3 ge3 siu1 sik1 ho2 ji5 zan3 ging1 cyun4 kau4

rows.traditional: 搞到 A 目瞪口呆
rows.jyutping: gaau2 dou3 A muk6 dang6 hau2 daai1
rows.note: Use this when something leaves someone completely dumbfounded or speechless rather than merely startled.

example.english: This news can stun me into silence.
example.traditional: 呢個消息搞到我目瞪口呆。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 siu1 sik1 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 muk6 dang6 hau2 daai1
